audio.text: Have you signed the roommate agreement yet?

options: My roommate is from Brazil, actually.
I agree that the room is too small.
Not yet; I want to read the part about guests first.
Yes, I finally signed up for the gym and the pool on Monday.

why.en: Yes/no question → "not yet" with a reason. A repeats "roommate" without answering; B repeats "agree" in another sense; D says "Yes" about something else.
why.tr: Evet/hayır sorusu → gerekçeli "henüz değil". A "roommate" kelimesini cevap vermeden tekrar ediyor; B "agree" kelimesini başka anlamda kullanıyor; D başka bir şey için "Yes" diyor.
why.es: Pregunta de sí/no → "todavía no" con un motivo. A repite "roommate" sin responder; B usa "agree" con otro sentido; D dice "Yes" sobre otra cosa.
